confidence_gate.why_not_submitted: Saved nsys times cover whole fused kernels, not combine. More combine CTAs, fewer static SASS sites and fewer compiler spill bytes do not establish a lower bound on cycle savings. Extra small TMA commands can offset parallelism. With no measured positive lower bound, >7000 confidence is insufficient.
confidence_gate.needed_evidence: Matched representative GPU phase/cycle timing plus existing numerical/graph gates and official workload/model validation. No job is scheduled to obtain that evidence under the current restriction.
